vibe: Futuristic, analytical, exposing the truth, cyber-security, premium startup, high-tech.

typography.heading: Unbounded, sans-serif
rules: Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, Tiny (text-xs), and Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Never use default bold for headers, use Light for elegance or Black for impact if variable font supports it.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-12) for marketing, Dense Control Room grid for Dashboard.
layout_spacing.dashboard_grid: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap tight (gap-4 or gap-6). Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layout_spacing.marketing_grid: Bento Grid Tetris Mode. Asymmetry. Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with varied spans.

surfaces.cards: Glassmorphism (Crystal variant): bg-white/5 or bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border border-white/10. Soft diffuse shadow. Hover: slight lift and border color darkens/glows.
surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10.
surfaces.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)] on critical data elements (gauge meters, prediction labels).

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary CTA: bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500 text-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]. Secondary: bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-black/40 border-white/10 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 text-white.
components.gauge_meter: Recharts radial bar or custom SVG. Neon colors based on score (Red < 40, Yellow 40-70, Green > 70). Needs blur/glow filters to look like a HUD.
components.suspicious_phrases: Rendered as text spans with bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30 rounded px-1 animate-pulse for tension.
components.badges: Prediction Label badges should use solid high-contrast neon variants, e.g., bg-red-500/20 text-red-500 border border-red-500/50 for Fake.

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-in up for lists/history. Use framer-motion.
animations.data_reveal: Matrix-style character decode effect or typewriter effect for AI reasoning text to feel like an active terminal.
animations.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a 'Kinetic Texture' in the background of the landing page.

images.description: Abstract futuristic dark background with glowing cyan and purple optical fibers. Overlay with bg-black/50.
Minimalist dark 3D glassmorphism spheres hovering in a dark void. Good for the About or Features section.
Macro shot of a glowing neon cyan grid scanning a matte black surface. Great for the Analyzer loading state or background.
Professional team portrait of three diverse tech founders in a modern dark office. Use on the About page.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text over dark backgrounds. Use text-shadow if placed over complex background images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='analyze-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend Tailwind config to include custom colors (base: #05050A, surface: #0B0B14) and set body bg to base.
Install Unbounded, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono fonts and apply them in index.css.
Build the Dashboard page using CSS Grid following the 'Control Room' protocol with tight gaps.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use the tinted deep black #05050A.
Implement the 'suspicious phrases' highlighter logic on the Analyzer page to wrap matched substrings in glowing inline spans.
For Recharts (History Dashboard), customize the tooltips and grid lines to match the glassmorphism dark theme (stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.1)).
Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions.
Ensure the hero image has an explicit bg-black/50 overlay to guarantee text readability.
